== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (main subject, white hair, glasses, black North Face jacket, green card sleeves) and [[Jack Douglass]] (background right, glasses, hair bun, black graphic tee) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
